name: Summon Greater Wondrous Item
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [chaotic, glamer]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, summoner 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 0 ft.
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

As summon wondrous item, but this spell summons one random wondrous item from the Medium Wondrous Item table.
